text: Vote For a Real Democrat - Monique For NY

Monique Chandler-Waterman is running to be the next Assemblymember for the 58th Assembly District because she knows that community comes first. A lifelong Brooklynite, her story is one of service - as a public servant, advocate, and activist.

The daughter of Bajan and Jamaican immigrants, and a lifelong resident of district 58 which includes East Flatbush, Canarsie and Brownsville communities. Monique’s record of activism spans two decades.

Monique Chandler-Waterman is running to be the next Assemblymember for the 58th Assembly District because she knows that community comes first. A lifelong Brooklynite, her story is one of service - as a public servant, advocate, and activist.

The daughter of Bajan and Jamaican immigrants, and a lifelong resident of district 58 which includes East Flatbush, Canarsie and Brownsville communities. Monique’s record of activism spans two decades.

“I’m proud to endorse Monique to be the next Assemblymember, and I know the district will be in good hands. She is a natural leader in every sense of the word and her roots go deep in this community. Monique is the best of us and she will fight to make sure everyone has access to quality public schools, affordable housing and community-based health care.”
Resources for our neighbors and small businesses as they continue to recover from the pandemic
Quality public schools for all students throughout the district
Truly affordable housing and policies that protect homeowners from predatory buyers
Accessible mental health services that address the needs of our community
A public safety system that is equitable and ensures our streets are safe
PAID FOR BY MONIQUE FOR NY
